subject: Rework-aware per-task cost accumulation (report on agent-run finish)
description:
Fix the cost-attribution gap: background Agent-tool workers' token spend never reaches the graph ledger (SubagentStop hook doesn't fire for run_in_background spawns; start_task self-registers but carries no usage), so per-task cost rolls into the /costflow unattributed bucket. VERIFIED: ov.usage_records had zero slices for the just-completed code-judge tasks despite ~160k output tokens spent.

DESIGN (per user):
1. Report on EVERY agent-run FINISH, not only terminal complete_task — because the task lifecycle is multi-turn/multi-attempt: worker run (+impl tokens) -> code-judge run (+review tokens) -> KICK BACK -> another worker run (+impl) -> another judge run (+review) -> complete. A kicked-back worker and every judge run must each contribute.
2. ACCUMULATE keyed by task_key, never overwrite. Today ov.usage_records[agent_id]=slice is keyed by agent and overwrites; multi-attempt needs a per-task sum across all agent finishes. cost(task) = sum of all run reports.
3. ROLE-TAGGED: each report tagged implementation vs review/judge, so per-task cost = Σ impl + Σ review and rework (2x impl + 2x review on a bounced task) is visible. Metric unit stays output_tokens (bench convention).

OPEN QUESTION to resolve (token source for background spawns — a subagent can't see its own count): (a) daemon parses the agent's transcript by agent_id/transcript_path (reuses existing usageApi.normalizeReported / usageCached path — RECOMMENDED, no trust on the agent to self-count); (b) dispatcher relays the harness-reported subagent_tokens to the daemon on the completion notification, keyed by worker agent_id+task_key; (c) worker self-reports a number it cannot reliably obtain (weakest). Likely (a) as primary with (b) as fallback.

Touch points: routes/exec.js (/agent/complete slice write, lines ~51-58), lib/usage.js (normalize), routes/analytics.js (/costflow + per-task rollup, ~189-207), and the report entrypoint (new MCP tool or extend complete_task/an /agent/finish call). Add a per-task cost rollup endpoint that returns {task_key, impl_tokens, review_tokens, total, attempts}.

summary: Rework-aware, role-tagged per-task cost accumulation shipped. Added ov.task_costs rollup that ACCUMULATES one contribution per agent-run finish (vs usage_records which is keyed by agent_id and overwrites), role-tagged impl|review, populated on every /agent/done (decoupled from terminal complete_task — kicked-back worker re-runs + judge runs each contribute). Files: lib/usage-accounting.js (roleForSlice, recordTaskCost with run_id=agent_id|endedAt dedup, taskCost), routes/exec.js (recordUsageOnDone calls recordTaskCost + honors explicit body.role/agent.role for attempt-branch judges; background Agent-tool workers captured via existing claim-window transcript sample, no SubagentStop needed), routes/analytics.js (GET /task/cost[?task=key] → {task_key,impl_tokens,review_tokens,total,attempts}), lib/overlay.js (task_costs in EMPTY+LOCAL_FIELDS, persists). Token source = daemon transcript parse by claim window (extends 2b42bcb), not agent self-report. Tests: new test/task-cost-accum.test.js 13/13 (multi-attempt 2 impl+2 judge → Σimpl=1800/Σreview=500/total=2300/attempts=4, role classification, idempotency); regressions token-attr 5/5, usage-accounting 11/11, overlay-split 32/32, judge-node-cost 14/14, costflow 34/34. Committed to branch as 8041bcf. NOTE: daemon restart needed to serve the new /task/cost endpoint.
